open_points: The safety allocation is pending review and no software safety requirement is allocated yet, making it impossible to determine if the requirement SWR-002 is objectively verifiable.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is started, the IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0x0000AAAA to IWDG_KR.KEY to refresh the watchdog counter.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the register array element ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U] has the value 0x0000AAAA written to it.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver enables write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0x00005555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the register array element ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U] has the value 0x00005555 written to it.

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver disables write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write a key value different from 0x00005555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the register array element ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U] has any value other than 0x00005555 written to it.

requirements.statement: When starting the watchdog, the IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0x0000CCCC to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the register array element ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_KR_OFFSET/4U] has the value 0x0000CCCC written to it.
